developing practical solutions that help operators leverage the benefits of WiFi while ensuring that user traffic is optimally offloaded.
providing operators with the ability to intelligently control user traffic across cellular-WiFi networks, thereby improving the user experience.
providing a practical traffic offloading solution that is both QoE-aware and cost-effective.

our system can be used by operators to provide better QoE to their users.
